mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
This unit has been detected by Warwick, all enemy players have vision of this unit.
"Prende la moto"
<mainText>While attacking, Warwick will steal more and more Health with each successive attack.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Each of Warwick's attacks will heal him. Each successive attack against the same target will steal more and more Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Warwick's basic attacks deal <magicDamage>@OnHitDamage@ bonus magic damage</magicDamage> and <healing>heal</healing> him for an equal amount. This effect stacks with each consecutive hit up to 3 times.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blood Awareness</titleLeft><mainText>Nearby enemy champions at low health will send Warwick into a frenzy.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>This unit is helpless before Warwick's savage assault and can take no actions.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick passively senses weakened enemy champions around him.  The scent of blood sends him into a fury, causing him to move at incredible speeds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <spellPassive>Passive: </spellPassive>Warwick senses enemy champions under 50% Health within @Range@ distance of him; while he detects a low-health enemy, he gains <speed>@MSBonus*100@% Movement Speed</speed>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Takes a bite out of an enemy unit and heals Warwick.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Strikes an enemy for the greater value between <magicDamage>@TotalFlatDamage@</magicDamage> and <magicDamage>@MaxHealthDamage*100@% + @APDamage@</magicDamage> of the target's maximum Health as <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> (can only do flat damage to monsters), and <healing>heals</healing> Warwick for @HealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick lunges at an enemy champion, suppressing his target and dealing magic damage for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Warwick lunges in front of an enemy champion and Suppresses them for @RDuration@ seconds. During this time, Warwick attacks his victim @NumberOfHits@ times, dealing a total of @TotalDamage@ magic damage (triggers on-hit effects @NumberOfHits@ times).

Warwick gains @BonusLifesteal*100@% Life Steal for the duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick lets out a howl, increasing all friendly champions' Attack Speed for a short time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Warwick lets out a howl that inspires all allied champions, increasing Warwick's <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @AttackSpeedMod*100@%</attackSpeed> and all friendly champions' <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @AllyAttackSpeedMod*100@%</attackSpeed> for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
